name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 24, 2021 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by San Diego Community Power – Phased Electricity Service Launch
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 10, 2021 Special Meeting-Closed Session and February 10, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-02-24 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants.
2021-02-24 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Additional Work to Complete the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project (CS19B). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize an increase of $118,019 to the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project construction contract with Tri-Group from $1,829,686 to a new not-to-exceed amount of $1,947,705; 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Contract Amendment No. 6 in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, to the Agreement for As-Needed Engineering Services with NV5 to provide additional construction management services on the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements project for an additional amount of $110,000. If approved, the total not-to-exceed amount on the Agreement for As-Needed Engineering Services with NV5 would be $860,000; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-10 entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Adopted Budget” to allocate $208,307 to the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-02-24 Item 08C Morning Sun Drive Amendment #6 CS19B
8D.
Contract with KOA Corporation for Preparation of a Local Road Safety Plan (WC20E). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Goralka
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with KOA Corporation in the amount of $78,500 for preparation of a citywide Local Road Safety Plan (LRSP).
2021-02-24 Item 08D Contract with KOA for a Local Road Safety Plan Preparation WC20E
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Council to meet with applicants and make one appointment to fill the District 3 City Council vacancy with a term ending December 2022. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Consider each applicant’s qualifications and interest in serving on the City Council, discuss and make one appointment to fill the District 3 City Council vacancy with a term ending December 2022.
2021-02-24 Item 10A District 3 Council Applicant Interviews-Appointment
2021-02-24 Item 10A District 3 Council Applicant Interviews-Appointment Public Comments Received
10B.
Selection of "Power 100" (100% renewable power) as the default electricity service for San Diego Community Power customers within the City of Encinitas, including the City's municipal accounts. Contact Person: CAP Administrator Najera
Adopt Resolution 2021-17, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing San Diego Community Power's Premium Product (Power100) as the Default Electricity Service for all Customer Accounts (Municipal, Commercial, Industrial and Residential) within the City of Encinitas" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-02-24 Item 10B SDCP Power100 Default Rate
10C.
Updating the Stop Sign Implementation Policy and Selection of Eolus Avenue/Andrew Avenue and Hillcrest Drive Intersection Design Modification Options. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
1) Approve staff recommendation on updating the Stop Sign Implementation policy; and 2) Select one of the proposed intersection design modification options for the intersection of Eolus Avenue/Andrew Avenue and Hillcrest Drive. The All Way Stop Control (AWSC) option already has an adopted Ordinance. Between the striping modification scenario and the neighborhood traffic circle, the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (T&PSC) recommended the neighborhood traffic circle option
2021-02-24 Item 10C Update to the Stop Sign Notification Policy
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Mayor Catherine Blakespear and Councilmember Kellie Hinze regarding Restaurant Delivery Fee Caps.
Direct staff to return with an emergency ordinance capping the fees charged to restaurants by meal delivery companies at 15 percent of the menu price of the delivered items.
2021-02-24 Item 12A Delivery Fee Caps
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 10, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
